MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The USB hub and extension cables would help me connect and reach accessories I already use, especially my memory card reader.",
    "The 32GB microSD card with an adapter fits my repeated memory card purchases and would be useful as a spare."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Buying a TV, DVD player, and Fire tablet does not mean I currently want streaming equipment, smart speakers, or a replacement tablet.",
    "My camera accessories support photography; they do not imply that I want home security cameras. Likewise, buying cables does not mean I need six short Ethernet cables.",
    "The earbuds do not address a need reflected in my recent accessory purchases."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My Fire tablet purchase seems to have been treated as interest in a wider range of Amazon devices, even though my follow-up purchases helped me use the tablet I already had.",
    "Broad similarities such as cameras or cables seem to matter too much when the recommended items serve different purposes from the things I bought."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "I repeatedly buy practical accessories that connect, protect, store, or support existing equipment, so a clear use with something I own matters to me.",
    "Repeated memory card purchases suggest an ongoing need for spare storage, while an earlier tablet or TV purchase alone does not establish a replacement need.",
    "Cable type, length, and quantity matter: USB extensions have a plausible use with my accessories, but six one-foot network cables do not meet a current need."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognize my need for storage and connectivity accessories but stretch my device purchases into interests in upgrades and smart-home equipment that I have not expressed."
}
